app.title: Control modes
app.intro: One widget, four ways to control it. Every mode offers the same five actions. Clicking or tapping the widget and the Confirm and Clear buttons always work, whichever mode is active.
app.demoNote: Demonstration widget with placeholder options. It holds no information about real places.
lang.label: Language
panel.heading: Active mode: {mode}
keyboard.intro: Move into the list with Tab, then use these keys. Tab and Shift+Tab always move on, so focus is never trapped.
switch.intro: Two switches. Step moves the highlight along the list of actions. Select runs the highlighted action.
switch.keys: A hardware switch that sends the key 1 acts as Step, and 2 acts as Select.
voice.intro: This version does not use a microphone and does no speech recognition. Type or paste a command, or use your device's dictation, then send it.
voice.label: Command
voice.unknown: Command not recognised: {heard}. Nothing was changed. Say {help} to hear the commands.
gaze.intro: Simulated gaze. The pointer stands in for eye tracking. No eye-tracking hardware or software is used.
gaze.dwellInfo: Rest the pointer on a target for {seconds} seconds to select it. Pressing a target with the keyboard or a tap counts as a finished dwell.
widget.title: Choose an option
widget.instructions: Move to an option, choose it, then confirm.
